nl_spec: Design a single-ended voltage amplifier in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 500 fF; input DC bias 0.75 V. Requirements: DC gain of at least 24 dB; -3 dB bandwidth of at least 40 MHz; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 87.5 uW; gain-bandwidth product of at least 384 MHz; output swing of at least 2.4 V; output DC level between 0.45 V and 1.35 V.

Design a current mirror in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: input current 20 uA, target output current 20 uA (ratio 1) at 0.9 V. Requirements: output-current error relative to the target of at most 0.65 %; output compliance voltage (minimum output voltage keeping >=95% of the current) of at most 0.156 V; output resistance at the nominal output voltage of at least 11.2 Mohm.

Design a continuous-time voltage comparator in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 50 fF; input common mode 0.9 V, overdrive +-10 mV. Requirements: propagation delay of at most 2.31 ns; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 24.4 uW; correct output polarity (1 = yes) of at least 1; output high level relative to VDD of at least 0.9 x VDD; output low level relative to VDD of at most 0.1 x VDD.

Design an active filter in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: lowpass response, stop frequency = 10 x fc. Requirements: -3 dB cutoff frequency between 1.46 MHz and 1.54 MHz; attenuation at the stop frequency of at least 43 dB; passband peaking of at most -5.8 dB; total power consumption (including the reference current) of at most 87.5 uW.

Design a clocked (dynamic) comparator in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: clock 500 MHz, input difference +-2 mV around 0.9 V. Requirements: clock-to-output delay of at most 150 ps; energy per comparison of at most 100 fJ; correct decisions (1 = yes) of at least 1.

Design a low-dropout linear regulator in the SkyWater SKY130 process (1.8 V devices, VDD = 1.8 V). Operating conditions: load capacitance 1 nF; input 1.8 V, reference 0.6 V, target output 1.2 V, load current 50 uA to 5 mA, 10 uA bias current at ibias. Requirements: output-voltage error relative to the target of at most 0.5 %; line regulation of at most 350 uV/V; load-step undershoot of at most 144 mV; PSRR at 1 kHz of at least 70 dB; load regulation of at most 0.688 V/A (= mV/mA); quiescent current (at minimum load, including IREF) of at most 31.9 uA; residual ringing (peak-to-peak) 7-10 us after each load step of at most 6.25 mV.
